column1: # STREAMS re-swept after the 1 MiB chunk and +cssc. N=2 was chosen on the old build, and the
# ladder batch that followed those two changes has v11 (3 streams) beating v12 (2) by 26 ms at
# 8 threads while v12 still wins by 17 at 18 — so the optimum moved, and it moved differently
# on the two clusters. Warm arm removes the read; pread arm is the shipping path.
